title: Linux 7.3-rc4 To Address Two Unfortunate Bugs With Btrfs
extract: Linux 7.3-rc4 is picking up two significant Btrfs fixes: restoring stable filesystem identifiers after a Linux 7.2 regression and fixing root-device detection for initramdisk-less GRUB2 boots.

title: Simple Optimization For Linux 7.4 Can Open Files For Reading ~39% Faster
extract: A small Linux VFS optimisation removes redundant dentry work in do_open(), with testing on a 20-core VM showing a 39% increase in read-only file-open operations per second.

title: Steam Frame Making Use Of Zink For OpenGL On Vulkan
extract: Valve’s Steam Frame VR headset uses Mesa’s open-source Turnip Vulkan driver and Zink for OpenGL, running OpenGL on top of Vulkan on its Qualcomm Adreno graphics platform.

title: ‘Star Trek: Strange New Worlds’: Paul Wesley on Playing Prince Dashing in Fairytale Episode
extract: Paul Wesley discusses the penultimate episode of Star Trek: Strange New Worlds season 4, including its fairytale setting and the developing relationship between Kirk and La’an.
